the previous practice manager Jane left, this practice has been declining steadily and noticeably. From the service provided by the newer GPs, to the constant failings and regression of the online services, to offer less than they did five or six years ago, everything is worse.

Now that Dr Trory has retired and Dr Koh has stepped down as a partner, the service has completely nose dived.

I'm writing this whilst I've been 'first in line' for 40 minutes and 45 seconds now, at 4:07pm on a Tuesday.

It's ridiculously difficult to get a doctors appointment. You cannot book online (despite them spamming adverts on the screens about how great their website is for managing appointments online etc., you can't cancel appointments either - if you can get one! Appointments booked via the phone don't even show up in your future appointments list).

The GPs and admin staff frequently violate GDPR by failing to include important information that is discussed in consultations or over the phone with them. They record incorrect information on your personal medical records, they do not inform you of test results but mark them as 'patient informed' and they mark things as 'no further action' that absolutely do require further action.

Example: told I couldn't have an appointment and had to submit an e-consult. Was told I'd get a call from the doctor on Monday afternoon. Instead they booked me in for a short notice appointment that I didn't know about, because I'm unwell with issues they're not helping me with and slept through the text, I missed the appointment.

They issued a 'Did Not Attend' warning letter for an appointment I was first told I couldn't have, didn't know about and didn't agree to. Refused to remove the DND even though it's their fault. Called that afternoon and was told I needed a wound swab, hence the appointment. I said I'd call back.
